Free key from build.nvidia.com

How to get your free API key:

  1. Go to build.nvidia.com
  2. Sign up or log in (completely free)
  3. Click on any model (e.g. Nemotron)
  4. Click "Get API Key"
  5. Copy the key (starts with nvapi-) and paste it above
